isolatedForeground.method: Entire foreground borderbox on a shared neutral backdrop; only body visibility/background changes, target visibility restored. Original foreground styles/content/geometry unchanged. Full-document capture avoids viewport scrollbars occluding the foreground; authored viewport dimensions remain unchanged. No pixel masks or tolerance.
